title: Managing your spending limit in a Green Account (checking)
summary: Explains how usable/available balance works in a Green Account (checking), including a small buffer of up to 5 for minor adjustments and that spending beyond it may cause declines. Covers tracking pending card authorizations, scheduling bill payments, maintaining funds until checks clear, requesting a stop payment for 28, and verifying balance before large purchases.
faqs: What is my usable/available balance and how does it relate to authorization declines in a Green Account (checking)?
